digest.component_or_area: code-review gate documentation and author guides
propositions: rebar review-code allows authors to preview code-review findings locally before pushing, but this capability is not discoverable to code-review authors despite being discoverable for plan-review authors
The local code-review preview is not surfaced in the author on-ramp guide (passing-code-review.md), the docs index, or the AGENTS.md canonical pointer
The loop diagram in passing-code-review.md does not show the optional local rebar review-code preview step
Surfacing rebar review-code in the same three places as plan review's local self-check closes the discoverability asymmetry between the two gates
The passing-code-review guide must document the REBAR_VERIFY_ENABLE_CODE_REVIEW enabling requirement and the [agents] extra for rebar review-code
